_about: NCAA D-I baseball conference tournament formats, 2015-2019 and 2021-2026, for 19 'other' conferences. Primary source: English Wikipedia '<year> <conference> baseball tournament' articles (raw wikitext read 2026-10-27: infobox Teams/Format, 'Seeding and format' prose, bracket templates), supplemented by conference/school releases found via web search where no season article exists. verified=true means a season-specific (or explicitly season-covering) source states the format; verified=false means carried from a neighbouring season or inferred. Conventions: two 4-team double-elim brackets whose winners meet = pods; single-elim opening round(s) followed by double elim = double_elim with byes = number of seeds skipping the opening round. Unless a source says otherwise, a single-bracket double-elimination final is recorded as 'if_necessary' (standard double elimination) and pod/pool winners meeting in a final as 'single'. MEAC omitted from 2023 on (its baseball members played in the NEC 2023-24; MEAC no longer sponsors baseball). The WAC rebranded as the United Athletic Conference after the 2026 season; 2026 is still listed as Western Athletic. The American Athletic Conference is styled 'American Conference' from 2025-26.

American.description: Top eight seeded by conference record play two four-team double-elimination brackets; bracket winners meet in a single championship game.

Atlantic 10.description: Top seven by regular-season finish play a seven-team double-elimination tournament; the top seed has a first-round bye.

Big West.description: No conference tournament; the regular-season champion receives the automatic bid.
Big West.notes: Big West held tournaments only in 1995-1998 before reintroducing one for 2025.

Coastal Athletic.description: Top six regular-season finishers play a modified double-elimination tournament; seeds 1-2 receive first-round byes and each round is reseeded (top remaining seed plays lowest).
